recipes.name: Lemon Butter Yogurt Chicken
recipes.description: Tender chicken marinated in a zesty yogurt, lemon, and butter sauce, then pan-seared to perfection.
recipes.instructions: Take a large bowl and combine the plain yogurt, lemon juice, melted butter, lemon zest, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder. Mix well until smooth. Add the chicken breasts to the bowl, ensuring they are fully coated in the marinade. Cover and refrigerate for at least 20 minutes. Heat a large skillet over medium heat and add olive oil. Once the oil is shimmering, place the marinated chicken breasts in the pan. Cook for 5-7 minutes on each side, or until the chicken is golden brown and cooked through, with an internal temperature of 165°F. Remove from heat and let rest for a few minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Yogurt Lemon Sauce Pasta
recipes.description: A creamy and tangy pasta dish with a rich yogurt and lemon sauce.
recipes.instructions: Start by bringing a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside. In a small saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and sauté for about 1 minute until fragrant. Stir in the lemon juice, lemon zest, and olive oil, then remove from heat and let cool slightly. In a large bowl, whisk together the plain yogurt and Parmesan cheese. Gradually whisk in the lemon butter mixture until smooth. Add the cooked pasta to the bowl and toss to coat evenly. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve immediately, garnished with additional Parmesan if desired.

recipes.name: Lemon Yogurt Parfait
recipes.description: A refreshing and creamy dessert parfait with layers of yogurt, lemon, and a hint of sweetness.
recipes.instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the plain yogurt, lemon juice, lemon zest, and honey. Mix well until smooth and creamy. Take four serving glasses and layer each with a spoonful of yogurt mixture at the bottom. Add a layer of granola, followed by a layer of mixed berries. Repeat the layers until the glasses are filled, finishing with a layer of yogurt. Garnish with additional lemon zest and a drizzle of honey if desired. Chill in the refrigerator for 10 minutes before serving.
